llm_description: 存储设备硬件信息及层级关系，包含型号、序列号、版本等属性，用于设备管理、告警关联与权限控制。

columns.name: hardware_name
columns.description: hardware_name。常见值: Container, Container Level2, Slot 6 - Temp: Outlet, Slot 6 - V: 1.5v, Fan 2/2, Fan 2/3, Slot 6 - Temp: CPU, Slot 6 - V: 1.0v CPU, module 0, Slot 6 - V: 12v

columns.name: model_name
columns.description: model_name。常见值: ISR4331/K9, PWR-4330-AC, ACS-4330-FANASSY, ISR4331-3x1GE, CISCO2911/K9, PWR-2911-AC, MSR900, MSR900 RPU Board, SIC-4GSW, ICG3000F

columns.name: manufacturer_name
columns.description: manufacturer_name。常见值: Cisco, Huawei, Cisco Systems Inc, H3C, RSR10-X-07, RedGiant Network

embedding_text:
存储设备硬件信息及层级关系，包含型号、序列号、版本等属性，用于设备管理、告警关联与权限控制。
表名: hardware
列信息: tree_level(父ID)
其他列: id, root_ne_id, hardware_index, hardware_name, description, model_name, serial_number, software_revision, hardware_revision, firmware_revision, manufacturer_name
